veranderings.rede: Blood enters INTO a person; 'by iemand inkom' reads like entering someone's house; same length.

veranderings.voor: Dit kan by 'n oop wond wees of by 'n naald
veranderings.na: Dit kan deur 'n oop wond gebeur of deur 'n naald
veranderings.rede: 'by 'n oop wond wees' is vague and wooden; the route is 'deur', and 'gebeur' picks up the previous sentence's 'Dit gebeur'; same length.

veranderings.voor: haar praatjie gaan oor bloed en julle sal later
veranderings.na: haar praatjie gaan oor bloed, en ons sal later
veranderings.rede: In reported speech the narrator's class is 'ons' (as elsewhere in the piece), and AWS needs a comma because both clauses have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: van 'n beker of 'n bord of 'n lepel
veranderings.rede: A list of three reads more naturally with a comma and one 'of'; shorter, same meaning.

veranderings.voor: Julle kan saam eet en julle kan
veranderings.na: Julle kan saam eet, en julle kan
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
Comma closes the relative clause where two verbs meet, so 'nies gee' is not misread.
Comma closes the relative clause where two verbs meet ('byt kan').

veranderings.voor: Iemand wat met MIV leef kan jou maat of jou onderwyser of jou ouma
veranderings.na: Iemand wat met MIV leef, kan jou maat, jou onderwyser of jou ouma
veranderings.rede: Comma where the verbs meet ('leef kan'), and a three-item list with one 'of'; the wording 'wat met MIV leef' is kept intact.

veranderings.voor: 'n grootmens te roep en dit is genoeg
veranderings.na: 'n grootmens te roep, en dit is genoeg
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: both clauses have their own subject and verb ('Die eerste ding is', 'dit is'); the safety instruction is unchanged.

veranderings.voor: As jy tog moet help sit
veranderings.na: As jy tog moet help, sit
veranderings.rede: Comma after the leading conditional clause where two verbs meet ('help sit'); without it the safety instruction is hard to parse.
A list of three reads more naturally with a comma and one 'of'; all three items and 'nooit' are kept.

veranderings.voor: Hulle gaan skool toe en hulle werk en hulle leef
veranderings.na: Hulle gaan skool toe en werk, en hulle leef
veranderings.rede: The chain of three 'en hulle' clauses is wooden; sharing the subject in the first half removes one 'hulle', and the AWS comma goes before the clause with its own subject.
Comma closes the relative clause where two verbs meet ('ken hoef').

vlae.teks: Jy kan naby haar wees sonder enige gevaar.
vlae.rede: 'haar' refers back to 'Iemand' (maat, onderwyser, ouma) but can be read as Suster Nomsa, and it genders a neutral 'iemand'. 'naby so iemand' would fix it but adds a word to a text at its ceiling, so it is flagged rather than changed.
